::: {.workshop-intro}
This workshop follows the path from first login to a submitted R job. The four modules can be presented live and remain available afterward as a practical reference.

**Audience:** Researchers who are new to Longleaf or shared computing clusters  
**Format:** Four short modules with demonstrations and reusable examples
:::

::: {.pre-workshop}
::: {.callout-note title="Before the workshop"}
Module 4 assumes four things are already in place. Each takes a few minutes, except the account, which can take longer to approve.

1. **A Longleaf account.** Request one on the [Request a Cluster Account](https://help.rc.unc.edu/request-a-cluster-account) page, choosing *Longleaf Cluster* as the subscription type.
2. **The UNC VPN**, if you will connect from off campus.
3. **[FileZilla Client](https://filezilla-project.org/)** installed on your laptop.
4. **The example files.** [Download the repository as a ZIP](https://github.com/crawfordcm/longleaf-presentation/archive/refs/heads/main.zip), unzip it, and find the `examples/` folder inside.

Module 2 explains each of these.
:::
:::
